title: EO Docs
intro: EO Docs: documents and sheets you edit together with other EmailOps users. Changes travel by email between your accounts, with no cloud.
empty: No documents yet. Create one with New.
selectHint: Select a document or create a new one.
readOnlyInvitation: Read-only until you accept. Accepting lets EmailOps email your changes to the people sharing it.
readOnlyLeft: You left this document. It is kept here read-only.

shareDialog.title: Share “{{title}}”
shareDialog.recipientsHint: Separate addresses with commas. They need EmailOps to edit; anyone else gets a read-only copy.
shareDialog.consent: I understand that EmailOps will automatically email my changes to these addresses, from this account, while the document is shared.

folders.name: Folder name
folders.deleteConfirm: Delete this folder? What it holds moves up one level.

attachDialog.title: Attach from EO Docs
attachDialog.warning: EO Docs only works between EmailOps users. Anyone without EmailOps gets a .eodoc file they cannot open.
attachDialog.consent: When this email is sent, the documents are shared with its recipients and EmailOps emails them your changes automatically.

import.hint: Import a Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .ods) file
import.skippedImages_one: {{count}} image was too large to import
import.skippedImages_many: {{count}} images were too large to import
import.skippedImages_other: {{count}} images were too large to import

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
deleteDialog.body: It is deleted from this computer, with its history.
deleteDialog.shared_one: It is shared: you will stop sending and receiving its changes. The other person keeps their copy.
deleteDialog.shared_many: It is shared: you will stop sending and receiving its changes. The {{count}} other people keep their copy.
deleteDialog.shared_other: It is shared: you will stop sending and receiving its changes. The {{count}} other people keep their copy.

exportPdfHint: Saves the document as a PDF in your Downloads folder.

conflicts.banner_many: {{count}} cells were changed by two people at once; one value of each was dropped
conflicts.banner_other: {{count}} cells were changed by two people at once; one value of each was dropped
